modules.name: cmd_decoder
modules.responsibility: Validate and latch command dimensions; generate tile schedule bounds

modules.name: tile_loader
modules.responsibility: Drive a/b/bias ready signals and fill tile buffers with counted payloads

modules.name: mac_array
modules.responsibility: Perform int8xint8 MAC over K into int32 accumulators for ARRAY_MxARRAY_N tile

modules.name: output_streamer
modules.responsibility: Serialize tile outputs, manage y_valid/y_ready/y_last and skid buffer
